title: delimtools 0.3.0.9008
text: run_bgmyc() — runs Bayesian implementation General Mixed Yule-Coalescent (bGMYC) species delimitation model via embedded C GMYC engine. Accepts ultrametric ape phylo object. MCMC likelihood evaluations performed C (C_gmyc_loglik) cluster assignments extracted C (C_gmyc_clusters), eliminating dependency external bGMYC package. Supports configurable MCMC steps, burn-, thinning, prior bounds, proposal scales. Returns classed "bgmyc_fit" list MCMC samples, per-tip cluster assignments, acceptance rates. Implements summary S3 method.

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9008
text: bgmyc_tbl() now accepts "bgmyc_fit" object (returned run_bgmyc()) first argument, requiring external package. co-occurrence probability matrix built precomputed $assignments matrix point-estimate partition derived via union-find given ppcutoff. legacy "singlebgmyc" path (requires bGMYC) unchanged.

Inner nodes without Newick label now receive sequential postorder label ("Inner_1", "Inner_2", …); nodes carry label file (e.g. bootstrap values) unaffected.

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9003
text: run_mptp_ml() run_mptp_mcmc() now correctly report singleton species (taxa form one-taxon coalescent group). Previously, tip coalescent root (.e. direct child speciation node backtrack tree) silently assigned species = 0 excluded result, causing returned cluster count lower equivalent mptp_tbl() run. Fixed build_assignments_ml() checking node->event == EVENT_COALESCENT && !in_coal tip branch inheriting parent’s species index. run_mptp_ml() run_mptp_mcmc() now return n_species = 1 likelihood ratio test fails (null model preferred). Previously dp_get_stats() always returned DP-table species count regardless LRT outcome, producing mismatch assignments (correctly placed taxa one group backtrack performed).

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9002
text: abgd_tbl() now accepts "abgd" object (returned abgd()) first argument, bypassing CLI path entirely. best_partition() called internally result returned standard tibble. type argument ("recursive" / "initial", default "recursive") selects ABGD pass use. haps filtering respected. asap_tbl() now accepts "asap" object (returned asap()) first argument, bypassing CLI path entirely. best_partition() called internally result returned standard tibble. rank argument (default NULL, .e. rank 1) selects ranked partition return. haps filtering respected.

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9001
text: run_mptp_ml() — runs multi-rate Poisson Tree Processes (mPTP) species delimitation algorithm (ML mode) via embedded C engine. Accepts Newick file path ape phylo object; supports rooted unrooted trees, single multi coalescent rate models, optional outgroup rooting/cropping. Returns classed "mptp_ml" list species assignments, log-likelihoods, LRT result, edge counts. Implements print S3 method. run_mptp_mcmc() — runs mPTP MCMC engine compute posterior support inner node coalescent root. Accepts inputs run_mptp_ml(); supports multiple independent runs, configurable steps, burn-, sampling frequency. Returns classed c("mptp_mcmc", "mptp_ml") list ML fields plus per-node support values MCMC metadata. Implements print S3 method. mptp_assignments() — extracts taxon--species assignment data frame "mptp_ml" "mptp_mcmc" result. mptp_species() — extracts species--taxon named list "mptp_ml" "mptp_mcmc" result. mptp_support() — extracts per-node posterior support data frame "mptp_mcmc" result.

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9001
text: Embedded mPTP C engine (v1.2.3, 2023-09-19 snapshot) src/mptp/. Includes DP, MCMC, likelihood, tree-parsing (rooted unrooted Newick via Flex/Bison), utility modules. external library dependencies beyond -lm. src/Makevars refactored per-directory pattern rules. abgd/%.o asap/%.o receive -include asap/r_compat.h; mptp/%.o receives -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DR_PACKAGE -DYY_FATAL_ERROR(...). replaces previous global -include asap/r_compat.h PKG_CPPFLAGS, cause null-pointer crashes applied mptp’s fprintf(stdout/stderr, ...) calls r_compat_null_stream initialised. src/delimtools_init.c updated rmptp_ml (9 args) rmptp_mcmc (17 args) call-method entries.

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9000
text: License changed MIT GPL-3, required embedded GMYC C engine (GPL-3).

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9000
text: abgd() — runs Automatic Barcode Gap Discovery algorithm entirely within R via embedded C engine (abgdCore.c). Accepts FASTA file path DNAbin object. Supports K80, JC69, TN93, simple (p-distance) models. Returns classed "abgd" list initial recursive partition data frames. asap() — runs Assemble Species Automatic Partitions algorithm via embedded C engine (asap_core.c). Accepts DNAbin object, dist matrix, numeric distance matrix. Returns classed "asap" list partitions ranked ASAP score, best partition, distance matrix used. Implements print summary S3 methods. gmyc() — runs General Mixed Yule Coalescent model via embedded C log-likelihood engine (gmyc_core.c) driven R’s optim(). Accepts ultrametric phylo tree. Returns splits-compatible "gmyc" object. Implements print summary S3 methods. spec.list() — S3 generic extracts species lists delimitation results. spec.list.gmyc() method compatible splits package output. best_partition() — S3 generic selecting best partition delimitation result. best_partition.abgd() applies plateau criterion (Puillandre et al. 2012); best_partition.asap() returns partition given rank (default: rank 1).

title: delimtools 0.3.0.9000
text: Embedded C engines ABGD, ASAP, GMYC src/abgd/, src/asap/, src/gmyc/ respectively. external binary dependencies. src/asap/r_compat.h src/asap/r_compat.c redirect ASAP’s printf, exit, rand, stderr, stdout R-safe equivalents; applied globally via -include asap/r_compat.h PKG_CPPFLAGS. ASAP RNG functions (unirandom, exponentialdev, poissondev) now defined src/asap/asap_wrapper.c using R’s unif_rand() reproducibility set.seed(). src/delimtools_init.c consolidates R_registerRoutines three engines single R_init_delimtools().
